connector.name: MCP by solinkify.com
connector.registryDescription: Pay for x402 paywalls, datasets, and store checkouts on Solana, behind hard spending caps.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.solinkify, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: SOLINKIFY_WALLET_PATH
env.description: Path to the agent's Solana JSON keypair (solana-keygen new -o agent-keypair.json). Needed by the tools that spend; discovery and search tools run without it.

env.name: SOLINKIFY_MAX_PAYMENT_USD
env.description: Hard cap for a single payment in USD (default 1)

env.name: SOLINKIFY_DAILY_CAP_USD
env.description: Hard cap for total spend per UTC day in USD (default 10)

env.name: SOLINKIFY_OWNER_WALLET
env.description: Owner mode (ADR-008): base58 address of the wallet that funds pay_checkout through its on-chain SpendAuthority. The agent signs but never holds the owner's funds; per-payment cap, daily ceiling and revoke are enforced by the Solana program. Unset means payments come from the agent wallet.

env.name: SOLANA_RPC_URL
env.description: Custom Solana RPC endpoint (defaults to the network's public RPC)
